title: Comparative analysis of GAN-based augmentation pipelines for Parkinson's hypokinetic dysarthria severity detection using deep learning.
summary: Results compare GAN-generated speech vs image augmentation for severity classification using 50 speakers (300 high/450 low utterances); speaker-level partitioning keeps each speaker in one fold. The source is an augmentation/model comparison, but the task is specific Parkinson hypokinetic-dysarthria severity classification; claims limited to dataset-level performance, not clinical validation. Learned CNN classifies a disease-specific speech-severity endpoint; augmentation comparisons do not establish diagnostic benefit or external generalization.
